name: Yagami Ran
source:
Ran has a strong sense of responsibility and she is cheerful. Sometime she has some priorities over others and that is personally damaging.
Her spiritual power is high from the time of birth, and it is said that the Yagami family is one of every 100 people who has it. Her mother, Kasumi, who realized that talent, gave her a spiritual sword that she had put in her spiritual power, and entrusted her to conquer the night with sword. To save my beloved mother who was sacrificed and gave everything, she endured harsh training and waited for the opening of the door to another world with the thought of Kasumi every day.
